resistance_scope: PS-43045 rev R 2025-11-14 pp12-13, low-level 20mV/100mA initial test and specified stress tests. Separate mating and crimp allocations are conservatively added; wire resistance is excluded. Not an as-built or flight bound, and not a guarantee at arbitrary currents or environment.
input_output_mismatch_prevention: Identical connectors remain physically interchangeable. Required IN/OUT harness labels and continuity inspection; mechanical key differentiation not implemented.
